product_vision: PreFlight is a guided pre-build demand & distribution toolkit for vibe-coded indie SaaS founders: ICP interviews, waitlist smoke tests, channel experiments, and a kill/continue score before another feature dump. North star: share of started experiments that produce an explicit kill or continue decision with evidence before more coding.

target_user_stories.persona: Vibe-coding indie founder about to launch
target_user_stories.story: As a vibe-coding indie founder about to ship, I want a structured ICP interview checklist and kill-score so that I pause or continue build with evidence instead of another abandoned MVP.
acceptance: Interview script covers ICP, willingness-to-pay, and distribution wedge in under 30 minutes
Kill/continue score updates from interview + waitlist + channel inputs
User can export a one-page memo PDF/Markdown
Progress persists in localStorage for the demo and via API for signed-in MVP

target_user_stories.persona: Vibe-coding indie founder about to launch
target_user_stories.story: As an indie founder, I want a waitlist landing smoke test with paid-intent checkbox so that I measure demand before writing more features.
acceptance: Generates or hosts a simple waitlist page with email + intent checkbox
Captures signup count and paid-intent rate
Shows target thresholds from Stage 3 (≥80 emails or ≥12 paid-intent in 2 weeks)

target_user_stories.persona: OSS-first SaaS founder stuck on linear adoption
target_user_stories.story: As an OSS-first SaaS founder with linear star growth, I want non-spam channel experiment cards (HN/X/adopter interviews) so that I pick one distribution wedge without forum spam.
acceptance: At least 5 channel experiment templates with success criteria
User logs outcomes (reach, replies, signups) per experiment
Scoreboard ranks experiments by evidence quality
Playbook copy explicitly discourages spam launches

target_user_stories.story: As a bootstrap founder on a personal card, I want clear $19–$49/mo or $99 one-shot pricing and a concierge sprint option so that I can buy validation help without an agency retainer.
acceptance: Pricing page lists monthly, one-shot, and concierge tiers
Checkout stub or Stripe Payment Link ready for validate phase
Receipt email confirms entitlements (kit access vs concierge)

core_features.name: ICP interview tracker
core_features.description: Guided interview scripts, note capture, and evidence tags feeding the kill-score.
acceptance_criteria: At least 8 interview prompts with required/optional flags
Save notes per interviewee with WTP and ICP fit tags
Aggregate count of interviews toward Stage 3 success criterion (≥12)

core_features.name: Waitlist smoke-test kit
core_features.description: Landing copy templates, email capture, paid-intent checkbox, and threshold dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Template landing with editable headline and CTA

core_features.name: Channel experiment board
core_features.description: Non-spam distribution experiments (Show HN sequencing, adopter interviews, star→user conversion) with outcome logging.
acceptance_criteria: ≥5 experiment cards with steps and anti-spam notes

core_features.name: Kill/continue score engine
core_features.description: Transparent rubric combining interviews, waitlist metrics, and channel evidence into kill / continue / more-data.
acceptance_criteria: Outputs kill | continue | more_data with rationale bullets
Export memo includes score and evidence citations

core_features.name: Concierge demand sprint booking
core_features.description: Optional $99 2-week sprint intake for founders who want human-guided validation.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form collects product one-liner and ICP guess
Calendar or email handoff for scheduling
Marks sprint status in founder dashboard

core_features.name: Static clickable demo (PreFlight UI)
core_features.description: Polished single-page demo for Spacefast private publish and interview walkthroughs.
acceptance_criteria: Covers interviews, waitlist, experiments, score views

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Founder can complete a full validate loop in the demo
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Walkthrough adds ≥3 fake interviews, a waitlist goal, one channel experiment, and produces a kill/continue memo

acceptance_criteria.criterion: API stubs support health, experiments, waitlist, and score
Monetization path is clear for validate phase
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: PRD and demo show $19–49/mo and $99 one-shot; no fake live charges in this run
Static apps/demo/index.html deploys as anonymous private Space with claim door

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No production secrets in pipeline pack
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Pack excludes .env, claim keys, and nested .git
FLOW_COMPLETE documents GO → PROCEED → MERGE → OPTIMIZE

success_metrics.north_star: Share of started PreFlight runs that end with an explicit kill or continue decision backed by ≥3 evidence items

key_metrics.target: ≥40% of active founders export within 14 days
≥5% of waitlist or ≥2 of 5 concierge sprints paid

technical_constraints: MVP is static demo + light FastAPI stub; heavy CRM/marketing suites out of scope
Local/demo Stage 8 plus Spacefast private publish only — no paid cloud production spend
No real Stripe charges in this pipeline run
business_constraints: Recommendation remains validate/medium; PRD enables learning not forced scale
Crowded advice market — differentiate on instrumented experiments + kill-score
assumptions: Founders will pay for instrumented validation over free Twitter/HN advice
A transparent kill-score changes build behavior more than guilt/FOMO
HN-only evidence is directional; second source needed before build+high

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Founders treat PreFlight as another checklist and ignore the kill recommendation
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Require explicit acknowledge of score; concierge sprint delivers human memo; measure behavior change in interviews.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Crowded GTM course market undercuts WTP
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Lead with instrumented experiments and score, not content; price at $19–49/mo or $99 one-shot.
Run Stage 3 validation experiments (12 interviews, 5 paid sprints, landing smoke test) before SCALE.
Hard-code anti-spam guidance in experiment cards; refuse 'blast HN' templates.

competitive_positioning.unique_value_prop: Instrumented pre-build validation with a kill/continue score—not another indie GTM course or launch checklist.
why_us_over_competitors: Ties ICP interviews, waitlist, and channel experiments into one decision score
Priced for bootstrap founders ($19–49/mo or $99 one-shot) vs agencies
Explicitly anti-spam distribution playbook for OSS-first founders
competitive_positioning.market_window: Vibe-coding made features cheap; distribution is the bottleneck now. Validate before the advice market saturates further.

monetization_model.pricing_strategy: Self-serve kit at $19–$49/mo or $99 one-shot; optional $99 2-week concierge demand sprint; later B2B cohort pricing.
